title: Ledger TRUNCATE bypasses append-only
evidence: LIVE-DB: service_role has TRUNCATE grant; BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE trigger does not fire on TRUNCATE
impact: Entire ledger could be wiped with a service-role key, undetected by triggers
recommended_action: REVOKE TRUNCATE ON apn_ledger_events FROM service_role; optionally add a BEFORE TRUNCATE trigger

title: Dual ledger hash schemes collide
evidence: SRC: domain-watch computes per-machine hash but ledger_chain() BEFORE INSERT overwrites hash+prev_event_id
impact: Per-machine hash never persists; misleading code; chain is actually single global
recommended_action: Remove hashing from Edge Functions OR make trigger honour supplied hash; document single global chain + version field

title: Ledger chain head has no concurrency lock
evidence: SRC: reads head with no advisory lock; concurrent inserts can share prev_event_id
impact: Fork/sibling entries under concurrent writes break linear-chain assumption
recommended_action: Take pg_advisory_xact_lock on a ledger key inside ledger_chain(), or serialize inserts

title: Ledger verification is APN-dependent and non-portable
evidence: LIVE-DB+SRC: payload hashed as payload::text (no canonical serialization); no hash-format version; verifier fns EXECUTE-granted to service_role only (not anon)
impact: 'Independently verifiable' / 'publicly verifiable' claims not currently supported
recommended_action: Define canonical serialization + versioned hash spec + offline verifier; grant read fns to anon only when privacy-checked (Sovereignty PHASE 2)

title: Anon reads internal columns on resources
evidence: LIVE-DB: anon SELECT grant on base table; RLS filters rows but all columns returned incl check_notes, verification_evidence, escalate_to_adr, source
impact: Internal ops notes exposed publicly for published rows
current_control: resource_register public-safe view exists but not used by anon
recommended_action: Switch public reads to resource_register view or restrict column grants

title: Edge Functions lack SSRF egress filtering
evidence: SRC: fetch() with redirect:follow, no RFC1918/link-local/metadata block
impact: Curated or redirecting URL could reach internal/metadata endpoints
current_control: URLs are admin/reviewed; Deno Deploy egress
recommended_action: Add egress allowlist; block RFC1918 + 169.254.0.0/16 + resolve-then-connect

title: pg_net installed in public schema
recommended_action: Move pg_net to extensions schema via migration

title: Dual migration ownership / drift risk
evidence: LIVE-DB: 7 UUID-named (Lovable) migrations alongside named CLI/Claude migrations; UUID SQL unverified
recommended_action: Freeze independent Lovable migrations during reconciliation; diff live vs repo (Codex)

title: Leftover anon SELECT grant on company_profile
evidence: LIVE-DB: anon/authenticated have SELECT grant but RLS deny-all masks it
recommended_action: REVOKE SELECT ON company_profile FROM anon, authenticated
